title: How to send an INTERAC e-transfer : Email Money Transfer
description: In this tutorial, you'll learn how to send an email money transfer or an interact e-transfer using your only bank account.  I use TD bank as my example but the method is 99% the same through most major banks. Parts of the screen are blurred out due to my private information.
